theorems.name: Submission.cbr_vague_portmanteau
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (νs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ (j : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → νs j K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(νs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => νs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) ∧ (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => νs j G) atTop)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
